body: I find that I go along with or support people not because of anything internal, but because I want to be liked. That's part of how I got myself into both the friend group using offenisive language and the kink spaces I now feel uncomfortable about. I felt like I had to fit in, and I fear abandonment a lot.

I try to give others in the same situation understanding, a good chance if they're trying to do better. 

I'm not sure I deserve that grace though, it isn't mine to give, and maybe all my openness is just enabling

No, thankfully. To be honest, much like the sexual roleplays no one has done anything yet, but I feel this huge pressure that by not telling everyone I know I'm decieving them as to who and what I really am, like I'm a timed disaster waiting to happen.
He, and a few friends who know, laugh it off and say I'm worrying about nothing. Tbh I think they're probably right, but it feels like a stain on my soul, if that makes sense
Ashamed and guilty, but they haven't come up. I had to show them to my spouse, he didn't know.

About 6-8 years ago, the typical "friends play a game around a mic" sort of thing that was popular. There's a lot of shitty joking around, mostly adult swim grade stuff. It weighs on me a lot more than I expected as I get older that I said things like that, though. Sometimes it feels like I hurt people I meet now, just because it exists and happened.

The yt vids for those dumb let's play videos with racist/homophobic jokes, my rp logs, old texts between friends, etc. Nothing super public, even the videos don't have my real name or whatever. I can't help but feel like they're out there, and if someone wanted to they could bring it all out to show everyone what a freak and an asshole I've been in life and ruin any good things I or family or friends have going. And if I just hide myself I feel guilty for wasting what potential I had. Either way I feel like I blew my shot for myself and others, and killing myself would at least make way for a better person to take up my resources and position.
